modalities.evidence: two sessions of testing: MRI scanning and behavioral tests
The second session consisted of only behavioral tests

output.population: Bilingual (L2) adults, native speakers of Mandarin Chinese; 56 participants
output.summary: Bilingual adult subset of the Reading Brain Project: structural and resting-state imaging, a reading task with simultaneous eye-tracking and fMRI, a diffusion scan, and a behavioral session. Participants were native Mandarin speakers tested in the United States and China.
